_comment: Test vectors for pasta-crypto. 'chain' pins Pasta's own key derivation (HKDF-SHA256 labels in src/keys.rs) for the secret 0x7f * 32, so builds that disagree are caught (cross-checked against Python hmac/hashlib HKDF). 'aead' is the XChaCha20-Poly1305 vector from draft-irtf-cfrg-xchacha appendix A.3.1 (ciphertext followed by the tag).
